text: Ko kanko nuli e Aarabeeɓe ɓe anndaano binndol e jannde ɓen, Nulaaɗo jeyaaɗo e maɓɓe, himo ɓe janngana ɓe Aayeeje ɗe Allah jippini e Makko, o laɓbina ɓe e keeferaaku e jikkuuji bonɗi, o anndina ɓe Alqur'aana e Sunnah, hari non ɓen ko ɓe majjunooɓe goonga ado o Nuleede e maɓɓe, tawde ko sanamu ɓe rewaynoo, ɓe rufa ƴiiƴe, ɓe taƴa enɗam.
